youtube.title: Julius Caesar's war update was 3 words 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
That one friend who replies in 3 words. Julius Caesar invented it 💀

What's the best 3-word text YOU ever sent? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in 47 BC Caesar crushed King Pharnaces II at Zela within five days of arriving, in a battle of about four hours. Plutarch says he reported it to his friend Amantius in Rome with just three words: "Veni, vidi, vici" (I came, I saw, I conquered).
